claim: 'Memes from the future' is a recurring format. A 2027 counterpart (Erosion/Opium Bird) already exists, so the format will likely roll to 2027 after November.
excerpt: Erosion Bird / Opium Bird, also called 'Meme from 2027', is an AI image unveiled Sept 2023; joke that a meme is so advanced only the future understands it.
title: What Is The 'Meme From 2027' And 'Polar Bear 2026'? The Lore Behind TikTok's 'Opium Bird' And 'Memes From The Future' Explained
